title: Pitch Coach prep pack
description: Written by the phase 3 agent to scenarios/<id>/pack.json. Validated on load by src/lib/scenarios.ts; a pack that fails is skipped with the offending field named in the app.

blurb.description: Two sentences: what this round is, and what it scores you on.

mode.description: Which app mode this pack practises.

topic.description: Goes in the Topic box. Names the company, role, and seniority.

targetSeconds.description: Where an answer is running long. From the dossier's timing finding.

greenZoneSeconds.description: Where you want to land. Roughly 0.8 x targetSeconds.

notes.description: Becomes the Notes field, which the coach treats as ground truth. A template for the candidate's own material — never a real person's details.

researchedOn.description: ISO date the research ran. Shown in the app so a stale pack reads as stale.

text.description: Asked the way a person says it. One clause, no preamble, never two questions joined by 'and'.

probing.description: What the asker is really testing, in one sentence.

briefing.description: The phase 2 report. Its rubric is injected into the coaching prompt, so takes are scored against these dimensions.

headline.description: One sentence on what this round is really testing.

format.description: Length, who is in the room, how it opens, where it sits in the loop.

theme.description: A question archetype from the dossier.

why.description: What that archetype is really testing.

rubric.description: 4-6 dimensions. Named the way the round names them.

weight.description: 'high' means failing it fails the round.

good.description: Observable in sixty seconds of speech.

bad.description: A specific failure with a shape, not the absence of 'good'.

trap.description: The losing move, stated so the candidate recognises themselves doing it.

instead.description: The concrete replacement, in words they could say.

prepPlan.description: Ordered steps doable before the camera opens.

url.description: Must have been fetched. Never cite an unread source.

supports.description: One line on what this source established.
